words.example: Winter will be busy, so we hope to hire two more registration clerks.
words.exampleZh: 冬天会很忙，所以我们希望再招聘两名挂号文员。

words.example: The outpatient desk is still trying to recruit a Saturday receptionist.
words.exampleZh: 门诊台仍在招募一名周六的接待员。

words.example: I nominate our senior clerk to take the minutes at Thursday's meeting.
words.exampleZh: 我提名我们的资深文员在周四的会上做记录。

words.example: Someone must appoint a new lead for registration before next month.
words.exampleZh: 下个月之前，必须有人任命挂号处的新负责人。

words.example: If this review goes well, HR will promote her to supervisor.
words.exampleZh: 如果这次考核顺利，人力资源会把她晋升为主管。

words.example: This rack has only two U space left, and the new array needs four.
words.exampleZh: 这个机柜只剩两个机柜高度单位，新阵列却需要四个。

words.meaning: 键盘视频鼠标切换（Keyboard Video Mouse）
words.example: Use the KVM (Keyboard Video Mouse) in rack six to reach the host with no network.
words.exampleZh: 用六号机柜的 KVM（键盘视频鼠标切换）去连那台没有网络的主机。

words.example: Bring a console cable; the switch lost its address and SSH will not answer.
words.exampleZh: 带一根控制台线，这台交换机地址丢了，SSH 不会有应答。

words.example: The serial console still answers when the management network is down.
words.exampleZh: 管理网断了的时候，串口控制台仍然能连。

words.meaning: 服务器底板管理（Intelligent Platform Management Interface）
words.example: IPMI (Intelligent Platform Management Interface) lets us power-cycle the host from the office.
words.exampleZh: IPMI（服务器底板管理）让我们在办公室就能给主机断电再开机。
